+def clean_optional(value):
+
+    value = clean_text(value)
+
+    return value if value else None
+
+
+def parse_datetime(value):
+
+    if not value:
+        return None
+
+    value = str(value).strip()
+
+    if value.startswith("0000-00-00"):
+        return None
+
+    try:
+
+        result = datetime.fromisoformat(
+            value.replace("Z", "+00:00")
+        )
+
+        if timezone.is_naive(result):
+            result = timezone.make_aware(result)
+
+        return result
+
+    except (ValueError, TypeError):
+        return None
+
+
+# ============================================================
+# 6. USER MAPPING
+# ============================================================
+
+def map_job_type_to_nature(job_type):
+
+    mapping = {
+        "0": "seller",
+        "1": "executive",
+        "2": "user",
+        "3": "user",
+        "4": "user",
+    }
+
+    return mapping.get(
+        str(job_type).strip(),
+        "user"
+    )
+
+
+def get_unique_username(old_username, mobile):
+
+    username_field = User._meta.get_field("username")
+
+    max_length = username_field.max_length or 150
+
+    candidate = clean_text(old_username)
+
+    if not candidate:
+        candidate = mobile
+
+    candidate = candidate[:max_length]
+
+    existing = User.objects.filter(
+        username=candidate
+    ).first()
+
+    if not existing:
+        return candidate
+
+    # Keep existing user's username if it belongs to them
+    if existing.mobile == mobile:
+        return candidate
+
+    base = f"legacy_{mobile}"[:max_length]
+
+    candidate = base
+    counter = 1
+
+    while User.objects.filter(username=candidate).exclude(
+        mobile=mobile
+    ).exists():
+
+        suffix = f"_{counter}"
+
+        candidate = (
+            base[:max_length - len(suffix)] + suffix
+        )
+
+        counter += 1
+
+    return candidate
+
+
+def get_unique_email(old_email, mobile):
+
+    email = clean_text(old_email)
+
+    email_field = User._meta.get_field("email")
+    max_length = email_field.max_length or 254
+
+    if not email:
+        email = f"{mobile}@legacy.invalid"
+
+    email = email[:max_length]
+
+    # Standard Django AbstractUser email is not unique.
+    # Check uniqueness only when the actual model requires it.
+    if not email_field.unique:
+        return email
+
+    existing = User.objects.filter(email=email).first()
+
+    if not existing or existing.mobile == mobile:
+        return email
+
+    base = f"{mobile}@legacy.invalid"
+
+    candidate = base[:max_length]
+    counter = 1
+
+    while User.objects.filter(email=candidate).exclude(
+        mobile=mobile
+    ).exists():
+
+        suffix = f".{counter}"
+
+        candidate = (
+            f"{mobile[:max_length - len(suffix) - 15]}"
+            f"{suffix}@legacy.invalid"
+        )
+
+        counter += 1
+
+    return candidate
+
+
+def get_valid_uuid(value, current_user=None):
+
+    if value:
+
+        try:
+            parsed = uuid.UUID(str(value).strip())
+
+            duplicate = User.objects.filter(
+                uuid=parsed
+            )
+
+            if current_user:
+                duplicate = duplicate.exclude(
+                    pk=current_user.pk
+                )
+
+            if not duplicate.exists():
+                return parsed
+
+        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
+            pass
+
+    if current_user and current_user.uuid:
+        return current_user.uuid
+
+    while True:
+
+        generated = uuid.uuid4()
+
+        if not User.objects.filter(uuid=generated).exists():
+            return generated
+
+
+# ============================================================
+# 7. FOREIGN KEY VALIDATION
+# ============================================================
+
+def get_valid_fk_id(model, field_name, raw_value):
+
+    if raw_value is None:
+        return None
+
+    value = str(raw_value).strip()
+
+    if not value:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+
+        field = model._meta.get_field(field_name)
+
+        related_model = field.remote_field.model
+
+        converted = related_model._meta.pk.to_python(value)
+
+        if related_model.objects.filter(
+            pk=converted
+        ).exists():
+
+            return converted
+
+        logger.warning(
+            "Invalid FK: %s=%s",
+            field_name,
+            value
+        )
+
+        return None
+
+    except Exception as error:
+
+        logger.warning(
+            "FK validation failed: %s=%s | %s",
+            field_name,
+            value,
+            error
+        )
+
+        return None
+
+
+# ============================================================
+# 8. NATIONAL CODE VALIDATION
+# ============================================================
+
+def get_valid_national_code(value, user):
+
+    code = normalize_digits(value).strip()
+
+    if not code:
+        return None
+
+    # Destination field has max_length=10
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{10}", code):
+        logger.warning(
+            "Invalid national code for mobile %s",
+            user.mobile
+        )
+        return None
+
+    duplicate = UserProfile.objects.filter(
+        national_code=code
+    ).exclude(
+        user=user
+    )
+
+    if duplicate.exists():
+
+        logger.warning(
+            "Duplicate national code: %s | mobile: %s",
+            code,
+            user.mobile
+        )
+
+        return None
+
+    return code
+
+
+# ============================================================
+# 9. PASSWORD MIGRATION
+# ============================================================
+
+def migrate_password(raw_password):
+
+    if not raw_password:
+        return None
+
+    password = str(raw_password).strip()
+
+    # Laravel bcrypt hashes start with $2y$.
+    # Django BCryptPasswordHasher expects bcrypt$ prefix.
+    if password.startswith(("$2y$", "$2a$", "$2b$")):
+        return "bcrypt$" + password
+
+    # Preserve existing Django encoded passwords
+    if "$" in password:
+        return password
+
+    return None
+
+
+# ============================================================
+# 10. PROCESS ONE USER
+# ============================================================
+
+def process_user(data, dry_run=False):
+
+    mobile = clean_mobile(data.get("mobile"))
+
+    if not valid_mobile(mobile):
+
+        stats["invalid_mobile"] += 1
+        stats["skipped"] += 1
+
+        return
+
+    stats["valid_mobile"] += 1
+
+    with transaction.atomic():
+
+        user = User.objects.filter(
+            mobile=mobile
+        ).first()
+
+        created = user is None
+
+        if dry_run:
+
+            if created:
+                stats["created"] += 1
+            else:
+                stats["updated"] += 1
+
+            return
+
+        if created:
+            user = User(mobile=mobile)
+
+        # ------------------------------------------
+        # User fields
+        # ------------------------------------------
+
+        user.username = get_unique_username(
+            data.get("username"),
+            mobile
+        )
+
+        user.first_name = clean_text(
+            data.get("firstName")
+        )[:150]
+
+        user.last_name = clean_text(
+            data.get("lastName")
+        )[:150]
+
+        user.email = get_unique_email(
+            data.get("email"),
+            mobile
+        )
+
+        user.is_active = str(
+            data.get("status") or ""
+        ).strip() == "1"
+
+        user.nature = map_job_type_to_nature(
+            data.get("jopType")
+        )
+
+        user.uuid = get_valid_uuid(
+            data.get("uuid"),
+            user if not created else None
+        )
+
+        # Preserve old password hash
+        password = migrate_password(
+            data.get("password")
+        )
+
+        if password:
+            user.password = password
+
+        elif created:
+            user.set_unusable_password()
+
+        # Save user
+        user.save()
+
+        # Preserve last_online because last_active_at
+        # has auto_now=True in the Django model.
+        last_online = parse_datetime(
+            data.get("last_online")
+        )
+
+        if last_online:
+
+            User.objects.filter(
+                pk=user.pk
+            ).update(
+                last_active_at=last_online
+            )
+
+        # ------------------------------------------
+        # User profile
+        # ------------------------------------------
+
+        national_code = get_valid_national_code(
+            data.get("national_code"),
+            user
+        )
+
+        province_id = get_valid_fk_id(
+            UserProfile,
+            "province",
+            data.get("state_id")
+        )
+
+        city_id = get_valid_fk_id(
+            UserProfile,
+            "city",
+            data.get("city_id")
+        )
+
+        profile_defaults = {
+
+            "national_code": national_code,
+
+            "address": clean_optional(
+                data.get("address")
+            ),
+
+            "post_code": clean_optional(
+                data.get("postcode")
+            ),
+
+            "province_id": province_id,
+
+            "city_id": city_id,
+
+            "job_title": clean_optional(
+                data.get("jopType")
+            ),
+        }
+
+        profile, profile_created = (
+            UserProfile.objects.update_or_create(
+                user=user,
+                defaults=profile_defaults
+            )
+        )
+
+        # ------------------------------------------
+        # Statistics
+        # ------------------------------------------
+
+        if created:
+            stats["created"] += 1
+        else:
+            stats["updated"] += 1
+
+        if profile_created:
+            stats["profiles_created"] += 1
+        else:
+            stats["profiles_updated"] += 1
+
+
+# ============================================================
+# 11. MAIN MIGRATION
+# ============================================================
+
+def migrate(dry_run=False):
+
+    logger.info("=" * 60)
+    logger.info("USER MIGRATION STARTED")
+    logger.info("DRY RUN: %s", dry_run)
+    logger.info("=" * 60)
+
+    users_data = extract_users_from_sql(SQL_FILE)
+
+    stats["total"] = len(users_data)
+
+    logger.info(
+        "Total source records: %s",
+        stats["total"]
+    )
+
+    for index, data in enumerate(users_data, start=1):
+
+        if stats["errors"] >= MAX_ERRORS:
+
+            logger.error(
+                "Maximum error limit reached. Stopping."
+            )
+
+            break
+
+        try:
+
+            process_user(
+                data,
+                dry_run=dry_run
+            )
+
+        except Exception as error:
+
+            stats["errors"] += 1
+
+            logger.exception(
+                "Record failed | ID: %s | Mobile: %s | Error: %s",
+                data.get("id"),
+                data.get("mobile"),
+                error
+            )
+
+        if index % BATCH_SIZE == 0:
+
+            logger.info(
+                "Progress: %s / %s | Created: %s | Updated: %s | Errors: %s",
+                index,
+                stats["total"],
+                stats["created"],
+                stats["updated"],
+                stats["errors"]
+            )
+
+    # ========================================================
+    # FINAL REPORT
+    # ========================================================
+
+    logger.info("=" * 60)
+    logger.info("MIGRATION FINAL REPORT")
+    logger.info("=" * 60)
+
+    for key, value in stats.items():
+
+        logger.info("%-22s : %s", key, value)
+
+    logger.info("=" * 60)
+
+    report_file = REPORT_DIR / "migration_report.txt"
+
+    with open(
+        report_file,
+        "w",
+        encoding="utf-8"
+    ) as report:
+
+        report.write("USER MIGRATION REPORT\n")
+        report.write("=" * 50 + "\n\n")
+
+        report.write(
+            f"Mode: {'DRY RUN' if dry_run else 'REAL MIGRATION'}\n\n"
+        )
+
+        for key, value in stats.items():
+
+            report.write(
+                f"{key}: {value}\n"
+            )
+
+        report.write("\n")
+        report.write(
+            f"Finished at: {timezone.now()}\n"
+        )
+
+    logger.info(
+        "Report saved: %s",
+        report_file
+    )
+
+
+# ============================================================
+# 12. ENTRY POINT
+# ============================================================
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Migrate Laravel users to Django"
+    )
+
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--dry-run",
+        action="store_true",
+        help="Validate records without changing destination database"
+    )
+
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    migrate(
+        dry_run=args.dry_run
+    )

import os
import re
import uuid
import django

# تنظیمات اولیه جنگو
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'config.settings')
django.setup()

from django.utils import timezone
from django.db import transaction
from applications.user.models import User, UserProfile 

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# تابع تبدیل شغل (jopType) به nature
# ---------------------------------------------------------
def map_job_type_to_nature(jop_type):
    mapping = {
        '0': 'seller',
        '1': 'user',
        '2': 'user',
        '3': 'user',
        '4': 'user',
    }
    return mapping.get(str(jop_type).strip(), 'user')

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# تابع خواندن و استخراج داده‌ها از فایل SQL
# ---------------------------------------------------------
def extract_users_from_sql(file_path):
    if not os.path.exists(file_path):
        print(f"❌ فایل {file_path} پیدا نشد!")
        return []

    with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()

    # پیدا کردن دستور INSERT INTO
    match = re.search(r"INSERT INTO `users` \((.*?)\) VALUES(.*?);", content, re.DOTALL)
    if not match:
        print("❌ ساختار INSERT INTO در فایل پیدا نشد.")
        return []

    columns_str = match.group(1)
    values_str = match.group(2)
    columns = [c.strip().strip('`') for c in columns_str.split(',')]
    
    # جدا کردن ردیف‌ها
    rows = re.findall(r"\((.*?)\)(?:,|$)", values_str, re.DOTALL)
    
    parsed_data = []
    
    for row in rows:
        row = row.strip()
        if not row: continue
        
        # جدا کردن مقادیر (با در نظر گرفتن رشته‌های شامل کاما)
        values = re.findall(r"('(?:\\.|[^'])*'|NULL|[0-9.]+)", row)
        
        if len(values) != len(columns):
            continue 

        record = {}
        for col, val in zip(columns, values):
            val = val.strip()
            if val.startswith("'") and val.endswith("'"):
                val = val[1:-1]
            if val == 'NULL' or val == '':
                val = None
            record[col] = val
            
        parsed_data.append(record)
        
    return parsed_data

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# تابع اصلی انتقال به دیتابیس پستگرس
# ---------------------------------------------------------
@transaction.atomic
def migrate():
    sql_file_path = 'old_data/users.sql'
    users_data = extract_users_from_sql(sql_file_path)
    
    print(f"🔍 تعداد کل رکوردهای خوانده شده از فایل: {len(users_data)}")
    
    created_count = 0
    skipped_count = 0
    error_count = 0

    for data in users_data:
        mobile = data.get('mobile')
        if not mobile or len(mobile) != 11 or not mobile.startswith('09'):
            skipped_count += 1
            continue

        try:
            status = data.get('status')
            is_active = True if status == '1' else False
            last_online = data.get('last_online')
            if last_online == '0000-00-00 00:00:00':
                last_online = None

            # 👇 اصلاحات مهم برای جلوگیری از خطای NULL 👇
            
            # ۱. هندل کردن ایمیل (اگر خالی بود، یک ایمیل موقت بساز)
            email = data.get('email')
            if not email:
                email = f"{mobile}@temp.com"
            
            # جلوگیری از خطای تکراری بودن ایمیل
            if User.objects.filter(email=email).exists():
                email = f"{mobile}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:4]}@temp.com"

            # ۲. هندل کردن UUID (اگر خالی بود، یک UUID جدید بساز)
            user_uuid = data.get('uuid')
            if not user_uuid:
                user_uuid = uuid.uuid4()

            # ساخت کاربر
            user, created = User.objects.update_or_create(
                mobile=mobile,
                defaults={
                    'username': data.get('username') or mobile,
                    'first_name': data.get('firstName') or '',
                    'last_name': data.get('lastName') or '',
                    'email': email, # 👈 ایمیل اصلاح شده
                    'password': data.get('password') or '', 
                    'is_active': is_active,
                    'uuid': user_uuid, # 👈 UUID اصلاح شده
                    'nature': map_job_type_to_nature(data.get('jopType')),
                }
            )

            if last_online and created:
                try:
                    User.objects.filter(pk=user.pk).update(last_active_at=last_online)
                except:
                    pass

            if created:
                created_count += 1

            # ساخت پروفایل
            if created:
                # هندل کردن کد ملی تکراری (اگر تکراری بود، خالی بگذار)
                national_code = data.get('national_code')
                if national_code and UserProfile.objects.filter(national_code=national_code).exists():
                    national_code = None

                UserProfile.objects.create(
                    user=user,
                    national_code=national_code,
                    address=data.get('address') or None,
                    post_code=data.get('postcode') or None,
                    province_id=data.get('state_id') or None, 
                    city_id=data.get('city_id') or None,
                    job_title=str(data.get('jopType')) if data.get('jopType') else None,
                )

        except Exception as e:
            error_count += 1
            print(f"❌ خطا در کاربر {mobile}: {str(e)}")

    print("-" * 30)
    print(f"✅ کاربران ایجاد شده: {created_count}")
    print(f"⏭️ رد شده (موبایل نامعتبر): {skipped_count}")
    print(f"❌ خطاها: {error_count}")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    migrate()
